settings.quote: Most hair oils put just enough of a “hero” ingredient on the label to tell a good story. We put in enough to actually change the ending.

settings.label: Hair Fall
settings.heading: Two answers to
settings.text: Bhringraj — “ruler of hair” in Sanskrit — has been used in Ayurveda for centuries to strengthen roots and reduce fall. Rosemary improves circulation to the scalp, waking up follicles so new growth comes through stronger. Use one, or blend both into your base oil for a complete hair-fall ritual.

settings.label: Thinning & Growth
settings.heading: Wake up
settings.text: Peppermint’s menthol brings a cool tingle and more blood flow to the scalp, and in research it grew more and deeper hair follicles than the control groups. Cedarwood is one of the classic oils in scalp-massage blends for thinning and patchy hair. Use one, or blend both into your base oil.

settings.label: Dandruff & Build-up
settings.heading: A clean,
settings.text: Tea tree is naturally antibacterial and antifungal — in a clinical trial it cut dandruff severity by 41% and eased itching and greasiness. Jojoba mimics your scalp’s own oil, so it lifts build-up without leaving it heavy. Together they clear the ground for healthy growth.

settings.label: Itchy & Sensitive Scalp
settings.heading: Soothe the scalp,
settings.text: Lavender is the gentlest of our concentrates. It soothes an itchy, sensitive scalp, has natural antimicrobial properties, and its scent is one of the most relaxing in aromatherapy — making your oiling ritual a real wind-down, which matters, because stress is a quiet cause of hair fall.

settings.label: Shine & Frizz
settings.heading: Smooth, glossy,
settings.text: Jojoba is a liquid wax that’s remarkably close to your hair’s own natural oil. It coats and smooths the outer layer of each strand, sealing in moisture so hair looks glossier and frizz settles down — without feeling greasy. Bhringraj has been used in Ayurveda for centuries to keep hair soft, lustrous and dark. Massage the blend into your scalp, then smooth what’s left through your lengths and ends.

settings.title: Blend
settings.text: Pour 30ml of concentrate into 150ml of your base oil — coconut, sesame or our Kehsora base oil (50ml into 250ml works too). Same 1 : 5 ratio. Shake well.

settings.title: Warm & part
settings.text: Shake before every use and warm a little of the blend in your palms. Part dry hair into sections.

settings.title: Massage
settings.text: Work the blend into your scalp with your fingertips for 3–5 minutes, then smooth what’s left along the lengths.

settings.title: Leave & wash
settings.text: Leave it on for at least an hour, or overnight. Wash out with a mild shampoo.

settings.title: Repeat
settings.text: Use 2–3 times a week. Most people see a visible difference within 4–6 weeks of regular use.

settings.use_text: Our concentrates are made to be blended into a base oil — that’s what makes them work safely and evenly. Here’s the ritual.
settings.warnings:
• Always blend first. Our concentrates are highly concentrated — never apply them undiluted to the scalp or skin.
  • Patch test a little of your blend behind the ear or on the inner arm 24 hours before first use.
  • For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes — if it happens, rinse well with cool water.
  • Stop using and consult a doctor if redness, itching or irritation appears.
  • Never swallow. Our concentrates contain essential oils — tea tree in particular is harmful if swallowed. Keep away from pets, especially cats.
  • Peppermint: keep well away from the eyes, and never use near the face or nose of young children.
  • Pregnant or breastfeeding, or under medical care? Check with your doctor first.
  • Not for children under 12 without adult advice. Keep out of reach of children.
  • Store tightly closed in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight.
settings.cert_text: Our ingredients come with Certificates of Analysis, and our base oil is tested by an NABL-accredited lab. Tap any certificate to read it in full.

settings.name: Rosemary
settings.subtitle: Scalp circulation
settings.story:
Benefits: Rosemary is rich in carnosic and rosmarinic acid, natural antioxidants that help boost blood flow to the scalp. Better circulation means follicles get more of what they need — supporting thicker, stronger growth and helping to reduce thinning over time.

In your oil: Blended into your base oil, rosemary gives a fresh, herbal lift. Massage it into the scalp 2–3 times a week to wake up sleepy follicles; it pairs beautifully with Bhringraj for hair fall.

settings.name: Bhringraj
settings.subtitle: Reduces hair fall
settings.story:
Benefits: Called “ruler of hair” in Sanskrit, Bhringraj (Eclipta alba) has been used in Ayurveda for centuries to strengthen roots, reduce hair fall and support new growth. It is naturally cooling and calming for a stressed scalp, and traditionally used to help keep hair dark.

In your oil: Ours is properly heat-infused, so a blend with your base oil carries real concentration. Leave it on overnight once or twice a week as a deep root treatment.

settings.name: Jojoba
settings.subtitle: Lightweight balance
settings.story:
Benefits: Jojoba is technically a liquid wax that closely mirrors your scalp’s own sebum. It absorbs instead of sitting heavy, helps lift product and oil build-up around the follicle, and strengthens the roots and the hair shaft to reduce breakage.

Great for your skin too: Jojoba is one of the most skin-friendly oils there is — it moisturises without clogging pores, softens dry patches and keeps skin balanced. A little of your blend works wonderfully on dry ends, cuticles, elbows and beard.

In your oil: It makes any base oil lighter and less greasy, so it suits oily scalps and daily use.

settings.name: Peppermint
settings.subtitle: Cooling & growth
settings.story:
Benefits: Peppermint’s menthol gives the scalp a cool, fresh tingle and boosts blood flow to the skin, bringing more nutrients to the follicle. In research, peppermint oil grew more and deeper hair follicles than the control groups.

In your oil: Blend into your base oil and massage in for a few minutes — the tingle is normal and fades. Great for thinning hair and a heavy, oily-feeling scalp. Keep away from the eyes.

settings.name: Tea Tree
settings.subtitle: Antibacterial
settings.story:
Benefits: Tea tree is naturally antibacterial and antifungal. It fights the flakes, itch and greasy build-up of dandruff — in a clinical trial it cut dandruff severity by 41% in four weeks.

In your oil: Blend into your base oil and leave on for an hour before washing, 2–3 times a week. Pairs beautifully with Jojoba to clear build-up. Never swallow, and keep away from pets.

settings.name: Lavender
settings.subtitle: Soothing aroma
settings.story:
Benefits: Lavender soothes an itchy, sensitive scalp, has natural antimicrobial properties, and in research supported more and deeper hair follicles. Its scent is one of the most calming in aromatherapy.

In your oil: The gentlest of our concentrates — perfect as an evening ritual. Massage the blend in before bed and wash out in the morning.

settings.name: Cedarwood
settings.subtitle: Thinning & balance
settings.story:
Benefits: Cedarwood helps balance an oily, flaky scalp and is a classic oil for thinning hair — it was part of the essential-oil scalp massage that helped 44% of people with patchy hair loss in a seven-month clinical trial.

In your oil: Blend into your base oil and take your time with a slow scalp massage. Its warm, woody scent pairs well with Lavender for an evening ritual.

settings.quote: “Nothing on the shelf actually worked — so she made her own.”
settings.heading: It started with a mother,
settings.text:
Kehsora began the way real Ayurvedic hair care always has — at home. A mother formulating her own oil from scratch, using real, purposeful ingredients, because nothing on the shelf actually worked.

That’s still the standard today. We talked to real people before building further — mall interviews that told us the problem was never the ingredients, it was the format. Some people love the ritual of oiling. Others simply don’t have the time. So we built for both: potent concentrates that mix into what you already use, and serums for the days there’s no time to spare.
